rules.title: Missing FROM instruction
rules.description: A Dockerfile must contain at least one FROM instruction to define a build stage.
rules.recommendation: Add a FROM instruction to define the base image and build stage.

rules.title: Copying entire build context
rules.description: The Dockerfile uses COPY . ., which copies the entire build context into the image and may include unnecessary or sensitive files.
rules.recommendation: Copy only the files or directories required by the application and use a .dockerignore file to exclude unnecessary files.

rules.title: Base image uses latest tag
rules.description: The base image uses the latest tag, which can cause builds to use different image versions over time.
rules.recommendation: Use a specific image version or digest instead of the latest tag to make builds more reproducible.

rules.title: Missing USER instruction
rules.description: The Dockerfile does not define a USER instruction for the current stage, causing the container to run as the root user.
rules.recommendation: Create and use a dedicated non-root user when root privileges are not required.

example.code:
FROM alpine:3.18
RUN apk add --no-cache python3

rules.title: Unlinked apt-get update
rules.description: The Dockerfile runs apt-get update without apt-get install in the same RUN instruction, which can result in stale package indexes in later layers.
rules.recommendation: Combine apt-get update and apt-get install in the same RUN instruction and clean the package lists afterward.

rules.title: Empty Dockerfile
rules.description: The Dockerfile contains no instructions or only whitespace.
rules.recommendation: Add valid Dockerfile instructions, including at least a FROM instruction.

rules.title: Invalid Dockerfile syntax
rules.description: The Dockerfile contains syntax errors that prevent it from being parsed correctly.
rules.recommendation: Review the Dockerfile syntax and correct the invalid instruction or syntax.

rules.title: Use COPY instead of ADD
rules.description: The Dockerfile uses ADD for local files or directories when COPY would be more explicit and predictable.
rules.recommendation: Use COPY for local files and directories unless ADD is required for archive extraction or remote URL handling.

rules.title: Possible sensitive data in ENV or ARG
rules.description: An ENV or ARG instruction contains a keyword commonly associated with sensitive data or credentials.
rules.recommendation: Avoid storing sensitive data in ENV or ARG instructions. Use secret mounts or provide secrets through runtime environment variables instead.

rules.title: Uncleaned package manager caches
rules.description: The Dockerfile installs packages without properly cleaning the package manager cache, which can increase the resulting image size.
rules.recommendation: Clean package manager caches after installation. For apt, remove /var/lib/apt/lists/*; for apk, use --no-cache or remove the package cache.

example.code:
FROM ubuntu:22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl

rules.title: Missing HEALTHCHECK instruction
rules.description: The Dockerfile does not define a HEALTHCHECK instruction, which can prevent Docker from automatically monitoring the container's health status.
rules.recommendation: Add a HEALTHCHECK instruction when the application provides a meaningful health check.
